description: Compare two specific names side-by-side. Read-only, deterministic — the same two names always give the same scores. Returns JSON with visual similarity, Jaro-Winkler, phonetic (Soundex) similarity, an overall confusion score (0-1), and a risk level. Use to compare two names you already have in mind; use screen_trademark to discover conflicts for a name across the whole register (it also weighs classes and live/dead status, which this does not). Does not assess meaning, commercial impression, or class relatedness.

nameA.description: First name to compare, e.g. NOVABREW

nameB.description: Second name to compare, e.g. NOVABRU

name: compare_marks
